solution:
The sum contains three equal addends, so it is three times \(3^3\). Expanding the power shows how many factors of \(3\) this gives:
\[\begin{aligned}3^3+3^3+3^3&=3\cdot3^3\\&=3\cdot(3\cdot3\cdot3)\\&=3^4=81.\end{aligned}\]
The answer is \(3^4\), choice \(\mathrm A\).
